## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4

- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
